items.Sentence: Seven pump stations (PS-1, PS-2, PS-3, PS-4, PS-6, PS-7, and the State Park pump station) convey raw sewage from the gravity sewers through three separate force mains (the Kelseyville, Corinthian, and State Park force mains) to an 840-gallon concrete collection box on the southeast side of the treatment plant.
The collection box has sluice gates to divide the influent flow between three aerated stabilization ponds if desired.
Pond 1 is operated as an aerated facultative pond, and Ponds 2 and 3 are operated as aerated stabilization ponds.
A fourth pond (Pond 4) functions as a clear well for the effluent pumping station.
Sodium hypochlorite solution is injected into the treated effluent at the filter screen guide channel just upstream of the effluent pump vault.
The effluent pump station has two pumps with a design capacity of 290 gallons per minute (gpm) each, or 580 gpm (0.835 mgd) total.
The seven P/E ponds, which are approximately 525 feet above treatment plant, are shown on Attachment C... (design data for the P/E ponds are summarized below).

Part of Treatment Pond 1 will be converted to an aerated lagoon system with both partially and fully mixed cells separated by baffle curtains. The fully mixed cell will have four 7.5-hp aerators, and the three partially mixed cells will each have one 2-hp aerator.
Phase II ... improving the chlorine disinfection system to increase contact time;

A previous order, WDRs Order No. 90-149, allowed the Discharger to land apply treated effluent to a 10-acre walnut orchard adjacent to the south side of the P/E ponds... The Discharger stopped using that area for effluent disposal...
